reviews.text: >Just Fail. Poorly implemented search. You can limit it to the services you subscribe to, which is awesome. Then, meh. You can limit it to movies, to eliminate TV, great! You can list Popular movies, and filter by year. Or you can search a string, and not filter. Not both. Want to find a Cary Grant movie from between 1940 and 1949? Good luck. This shouldn't be hard to program, but clearly it's beyond the wit of man.

>
Thanks for taking the time to share this detailed feedback, Justin. We understand how useful it would be to combine multiple filters when searching for specific titles. We’ll share your feedback with the team as we continue improving the search experience.

>Love the app, but please please stop auto playing clips while I am browsing my lists. It is extremely distracting. At the very least, provide a setting to disable it!! Update - the annoying audio is still there. Please consider adding a way to turn off sound. Also - your payment processing system is down. I tried renewing with give different credit cards and they were all declined (even though the credit cards are all active)

>Excellent app with an amazing support team! I recently migrated from TV Time, and they went above and beyond to help me import years of watch history without losing my data. They responded quickly, listened to my feedback, and truly cared about making the transition as smooth as possible. The content library is comprehensive, and the app is excellent for discovering where to watch movies and TV shows.
Find out where to watch your favorite movies \u0026amp; TV shows streaming online

Love the app. My favorite app for tracking shows and movies that I've watched and want to watch. But... lately, it's been glitching? or something. it just won't load and I have to uninstall and re install to get it working for a few days then it freezes up again. Frustrating for sure.

>Update:app apparently is no longer functioning. I wish I knew this so I could've transferred my date before it all disappeared. I have been using this for years since cutting the cable cord. Great for keeping track where you left off. If where you stream shows the last show you watched but it was someone else, or maybe you watched the show on a different device,live or someone elses house you can track it here to never lose track.

I'm heartbroken. 😔 January 2019 - Great TV tracker. Trying to keep up with TV shows on so many different platforms is pretty confusing. This app is awesome. The only con is when they change the format... it gets confusing again which is a bit annoying... But I'm still giving it a 5 star because it's efficient regardless.

The search feature doesn't work and the app crashes almost every time I use it. What's the point of a media tracking app that you can't search for any shows or movies on? You get message, \
for EVERY SINGLE THING you put in the search bar. Wish you could out 0/5 stars, this really doesn't deserve 1-star.

My last 5-star review was JUL 2019 so I've been using the app for at least 7 yrs. I hate that it’s ending! I looked at many alternative apps and they’re garbage! TV Time is the best. PLEASE consider keeping it going. Some users would be ok with ads; I would pay for a no-ads annual subscription. I found my people in the episode comments and will miss the daily joy of connecting with those who like the same shows! Save the app! Save us!

So sad to hear this is shutting down! Such a helpful and organized app, and I just went through to add movies last month after years of enjoying it for tracking shows. I hope you change your mind and add a paid version! I'm going to miss keeping track and will have to hunt for a new solution. \u003d(

app is pretty good but one bug that it has had forever which is very frustrating. if you click on your watch list for movies the list opens up right away. BUT when you click on your watch list for TV shows you are guaranteed a spinning yellow circle for at least ten seconds, sometimes as long as 30 seconds, and sometimes you get the classic a network error occurred and it doesn't open up at all. this has been going on for years..

Update: So I'm reading everywhere the app is shutting down? well this sucks. I'm 3 yrs into this app and still love it. If there's a pay option I want it! Awesome App! Has everything from keeping track of watched movies and shows, the total amount of time you watch of each, upcoming dates, favorites, where to find on streaming services, ratings, a comment section, reviews and so much more! Highly recommend this app for movie and TV buffs!

Edit: It seems the app will be shutting down this month. im really sad to see this as i would have been willing to see ads in order to keep the doors open. love this app! Its free and easy to use. i could never keep track of all my shows and TV Time not only lets me keep track of what ive seen but it lets me know when shows are coming back and what day and time they air.

I give up. Tried Showly and it just works. Good luck. Great app in theory, but over the years the network response has just gotten worse and worse. They need better servers or something. Impossible to mark a show watched tonight at all, even after waiting a minute or two for the page to just load. REPLY TO THE (DELETED) REPLY where they claimed they were just having server issues and they were fixed: That would be more reassuring if network/server issues weren't a weekly (or more often) issue.

I just learned that this app is getting discontinued! I had no idea and would 100% be willing to pay! The rest of the tv/movie tracking apps are just awful. Please don't let this app die! Love this app, seeing how much I've watched, always knowing when shows are coming out, and connecting with people who like the see shows.

UPDATE: Now I can't even use the app at all! Nothing loads, and after reinstalling, and clearing the cache \u0026 data, I can't log back in. Such a shame, after years of tracking my shows with this app... 😞 Great app just for tracking shows and movies, and reading comments about them, but it often loads slowly, and having conversations with people in the comment replies is difficult due to a flawed tagging system and the comments always being in reverse chronological order.

I've been using this app on and off, around 10 years or so now to track all of my shows and movies. It was the only app I used to do it because I liked the interface so much. I just find out today that they shut down their servers and only gave people two weeks notice to do anything about it. And now that everything's gone there's no way to export the data that I've accumulated for almost, if not a decade. Nothing I can do now. All because I didn't check on the app for a couple weeks. :(

Been using this app for a few years now. When it actually works, it's fantastic. However, considering it's experiencing network issues half the time, it makes for a pretty frustrating experience using the thing on a regular basis, requiring me to remember to go check off an episode once it starts working again. The main reason I haven't switched to something else yet is laziness and the fact that it's good sometimes, but if it keeps up, I'll definitely jump ship.

At the very least, Plex Pass users should be able to disable the Live TV, On Demand, and Discover buttons on the navigation bar. Also give me the ability to separate my movies & TV shows! This new layout is horrific.

Downgraded to 10.26.0.2578 and problems went away.

>I love this app! And I love that there are no limits to the number of watchlist items allowed or the number of custom lists allowed, even with a free plan (which can't be said about a lot of their competitors like Trakt). The only things that could make the service better is adding recommendations based on our activity and implementing TV shows, which their support team has already confirmed when I asked, but I'm REALLY impatient lol 😅

I love this app! And I love that there are no limits to the number of watchlist items allowed or the number of custom lists allowed, even with a free plan (which can't be said about a lot of their competitors like Trakt). The only things that could make the service better is adding recommendations based on our activity and implementing TV shows, which their support team has already confirmed when I asked, but I'm REALLY impatient lol 😅
I LOVE this app, great for keeping lists of movies you wanna see as well as keeping a diary of movies you have! My only complaints would be the lack of a \

system. Would love if I could also use this app to find new movies to watch, especially if they somehow based the suggestions off my previous watches/ratings. Also wish they wouldn't just constantly show all the movies currently in theaters, I'd like to be shown movies I can actually watch without making a whole trip.

I love using this app, and all of the features are great. It does crash a little after scrolling through films long enough. However, I finally got urged to write a review because sometimes it will log me out randomly, I'll try to login and it denied me each time. I even tried to reset my password and the same thing happened. Crazy thing is I went to the website and signed in and it worked, but wouldn't let me edit anything? Please fix this!!

My sister recently reccomended this app to me and I've really been enjoying it! I've been able to find every movie I've searched for and the options that free users have are pretty good. As I'm just getting started, I'm remembering all the movies I've ever watched and adding them to my lists, but after about 10-15 minutes, the app starts lagging really badly and then eventually quits me out.. It's a bit inconvenient. I'd also love to have a light mode for android as dark mode hurts my eyes.

Poor optimization. App became unresponsive and eventually crashed on my SD Elite phone (12GB Ram) after browsing through a few movies and clicking into a few actors. I also think there should be a TV section or better organization for viewing previously rated movies. Edit: Still not fixed 😑. This should be a #1 priority for the dev team, especially when it happens on just a last gen flagship android phone, an S25 Ultra. Pretty unacceptable and I'm considering other platforms or 3rd party apps.
This is a great app and service, with a few exceptions: 1. Adding a movie to a private list has confusing UI for saving; I often mistakenly hit the \
to submit, but that creates a NEW list. 2. I wish we could include a note when adding a film to a list, rather than forcing us to go through the tedious list-edit process. 3. The \

I like Letterboxd as a platform. This app, however, is a disappointment. Every time you scroll through films long enough, it will crash. More recently, I've been getting api timeouts consistently and it often takes too long to load, making the website a better option. The ads are also annoying, banner ads that often pop up right when you try and click on a film, redirecting you immediately.

I'm glad I have this app and I love using the service but there is a pretty glaring lack of a feature I consider very basic and necessary which is to save drafts of reviews or for them to at the absolute least not get closed out and erased if you leave the app for more than a minute. I understand that this is probably not an issue for everyone, but I tend to write long reviews and I can't always remember to copy and paste it in a separate notes app if I have to pause in the middle of writing.

This app is fantastic. Fun and easy to use. There's only one thing that I ask, and that's the ability to add the movie companies, i.e. A24, MGM, themselves to the lists that you create. Right now you have it so that you can add the movies from the companies to your created lists, but if you could add just the company itself also, that would be great, and five star worthy.

I love this app, I even bought patron, but it is really buggy unfortunately... sometimes the app won't open, sometimes nothing will load, and just overall I have to refresh or reopen multiple times a day because of a bug. Currently, I'm unable to open the app and it's really unfortunate. Other than that, the new interface is really annoying, and I still wish we were able to search within our lists on the app, because you can't find anything once you have too many lists...

I really want to love this app. The interface is slick but I have some grievances. Firstly it feels like an app that just pretends Android and Google don't exist in it's design. Also, it's very hard to find friends if you're not on Facebook. Could use some traditional contact linking or some other platforms. Also, only connects for media are Amazon and iTunes. Some minor tweaks and it would be a 5.
I do love Letterboxd and talking film in general. This app *has* been serviceable, but it has lately been auto-opening scam Amazon links claiming I \

Great social media app perfect for movie lovers. The only few things I don't like is that the ui isn't really user-friendly. It's not easy to figure out how to do things half the time and just needs some work. Also they should add tv shows, I'd love to rate breaking bad, or even some anime like dbz or others. There are anime movies though so that's a plus.

Hands down the best app for Movie fans! Its extremely easy to use, and it's a great way to track your movie watching experience over the years either through logging, rating, or reviewing. The social media aspect is really fun if you like to connect with other fans, but it's completely optional for those who don't want to add another social media to the mix. I used to use IMDb, but the community, app, and website have changed drastically over the years. Thankfully this app came to the rescue!

Been using this app for years and it's been great, but recently the ads have been getting worse and worse. Now it's at the point where you have to sit and watch an unskippable ad when you first search for a movie every time you log in. You can pay for a pro membership to avoid ads but with everything else being a subscription service these days I think I've had enough. Yet another genuinely good service going down the drain. So disappointing.

I have never seen an app automatically open up ads in a separate browser without you clicking on them first. There are also ads that cover all the edges of your screen, rendering the app unusable until the ad disappears. This is unacceptable. It makes the app incredibly annoying to use and opens up your device to security risks. Then they have the nerve to charge an insane $20 a month to just remove the ads. I want to use this service, but they are doing their best to push everyone away.

>I don't really like it. Most things on the app don't really work. I get emails with links to click that take me to a blank page in app. Some settings have no options to choose anything. Too much info that's hard or impossible to find on a small screen and too much doesn't work. App is useless for me. Uninstalling, it's a basic search engine. Expected more.

I love what the app is meant to do. Every time I see someone familiar, I look up their IMDb page. The reason for the 3 star review is for questionable changes. Before, the app would open up instantly. Now, it has a splash screen. Really? Not to mention the fact that I have to remind myself to wait because once I try to click on the search bar, I inadvertently click on an ad, trailer or whatever the heck decided to get in the way of the search bar. Please stop trying to make everything flashy.

I don't really like it. Most things on the app don't really work. I get emails with links to click that take me to a blank page in app. Some settings have no options to choose anything. Too much info that's hard or impossible to find on a small screen and too much doesn't work. App is useless for me. Uninstalling, it's a basic search engine. Expected more.

it's a fine app, but what I find most annoying is that it works better if you don't log in. when you log in, the search suggestions are recommendations based on your ratings/activity. when logged out, it shows your search history, so when watching a show and wanting to look up different details episode after episode it is way more convenient.

I use IMDb constantly. Every time I see an actor I like or who is familiar, I immediately open IMDb to take a look. I find a lot of other great movies and shows that I might not have heard of otherwise. It really helps expand my appreciation for other genres, actors, directors, and more. I like reading, but definitely don't make decisions off of critic or user reviews. Art like this is way too subjective. Being able to see what streaming apps I can go to for everything is extremely helpful!

My late husband got me hooked on IMDB long before there was an app. Of course the app doesn't have the content of the desktop version but until now it had everything I needed. Never used Google always used imdb. Now, there is no information. What is the point of using it anymore. i keep waiting for an update but I'm ready to uninstall if it's not fixed. I'd rather use the web version but since I have the app, when I click on a l9nk, it opens the app.So frustrating.

I can deal with the intermittent ads whenever I go through a movie's picture gallery but what I cannot deal with is when it opens my Amazon app automatically every single time I swipe left to see the next picture. I'm not clicking on the ad, just swiping it away and it still opens up the app. Makes viewing pictures a terrible experience.

I haven't been able to see the filmography for some time in the app (works on site). Using the app is a miserable experience. Nothing like using the live site. Everything is crammed together and difficult to navigate. Videos autoplay without regard for people that actually pay for data usage. Finding a show or movie is easy, and that's the only thing easy. No choice than to UNINSTALL!

error message is pervasive. For over a month, the IMDb app is barely usable. Opening it usually fails with the Inconceivable message. Tapping on search or your profile will also face delays. It's by far the worst major app right now. I've never experienced anything like this from a major app. To not be able to just open the app is ridiculous. This is very confusing. How is it possible to ship an app that doesn't even reliably open?

For months it has been very slow, won't open and freezes. I've been using the browser instead. I contacted costumer service. Their response was they constantly work on it to improve it. It doesn't seem it's working though. I may need to contact Jeff Bezos. After all, the app went downhill after Amazon bought it. I'm going to uninstall it because it's basically useless.

Good movie choices, however terrible ad placement. I mean, I know to keep the app free, theres going to be ads. No big deal, right? It wouldn't be a big deal if they didnt smack the ads in the middle of songs/scenes/lines. They just throw them in where ever and totally break up the movies. super annoying especially when it's right in the middle of an important scene. Save the ads for the ends of scenes please!

I have been using IMDb for over a decade and the website is extremely helpful. The app I've had for about 5 years and it keeps getting worse. It takes FOREVER to load anything, freezes, crashes, doesn't respond to scrolling or clicking, skips when it does scroll, opens up things I didn't click on. I can't understand why this app has had problems for so long and hasn't been fixed, only getting worse. I'm finally, after 5 years of hoping for the best, am uninstalling and just using the web page.

I have used this app for years, but it has gotten worse with every update. Especially now that the homepage has almost entirely disappeared, taking the trailers along with it. As well actors' pages no longer show roles, just movie/show titles. As well, you cannot find individual episodes of shows any longer. I used to love the trivia and ease of learning more about different movies, actors, etc. Now it is more of a unknowledgeable headache.
and that their engineers are working on fixing it. At this point, it is quite conceivable. Also, whatever is on the tab that has a circle and a triangle never loads, it just cycles the \

I love this app. Have been using IMDb before the app came out. Love all the information you get. And has settled a few debates over the years. You can find what you're looking for even if you can't remember the name of the movie/tv show or the name of an actor/actress. Sounds corny but it really is my go-to when lookin up anything to do with movies or tv shows. One thing I wish it had tho, is to be able to hear how certain names are pronounced... Would be cool if you added that.. just sayin..

There is way too much in a movie page that is not directly related to the movie. Quit advertising other movies on the pages. It's irritating to have to keep scrolling to finally get to the photos and videos for a specific movie i want to learn more about. If you insist on putting that extra stuff on there, then put it at THE BOTTOM! I'm so sick of companies and their obsession with product placement and ads. News flash!! - I will REFUSE to voluntarily click on ad's. PERIOD!!!
